events.summary: 塔拉辛独自站在隆冬的冰湖中央，四周是密林，七个月亮悬在布满星座的夜空。
events.quote: She was alone in the heart of winter, standing in the middle of a frozen lake surrounded by dense forests.

events.summary: 她朝远处岸边那个背对她的黑色身影走去，冰面在赤裸的脚下开裂，她喊出他的名字。
events.quote: She walked toward him. The ice cracked beneath her bare feet but she didn’t care

events.summary: 她终于走到近前再次呼唤，他听见了，转过身来。
events.quote: At last, he heard. At last, he turned to her.

events.summary: 从昏迷中醒来后，塔拉辛在接下来的两天里时醒时睡，阿拉里克始终守在她房中。
events.quote: She drifted in and out of consciousness over the next two days

events.summary: 南岸之战八天后的清晨，塔拉辛真正清醒过来，看见阿拉里克站在窗边，手上没戴护手、婚戒清晰可见。
events.quote: Alaric was standing by the window, turned to her in profile, his tall, black-clad frame etched in golden light.

events.summary: 阿拉里克说他不指望她还愿意维持婚姻，若她想要废除婚约他会配合，并承诺她开口要什么就给什么。
events.quote: I don’t expect you to have any desire to remain married to me. Not after everything that I’ve put you through

events.summary: 塔拉辛提出要一场蜜月、彼此坦诚、不带着怒气过夜，还说起幻象中那个像他但有她眼睛的孩子。
events.quote: I want a proper honeymoon. It will have to be after the peace talks

events.summary: 阿拉里克抱住她，反复说我爱你。
events.quote: “I love you, I love you, I love you,” he said hoarsely, punctuating each fervent declaration with a blistering kiss.

relations.quote: whenever she was lucid, she would be too tired to talk or even keep her eyes open for long, but her husband was always in the room with her

relations.relation: 父女；父亲为她忧心，留在要塞
relations.quote: Your father has been beside himself. I’ll have a runner sent to him right away.

relations.relation: 朋友；阿拉里克提议送信让她来见
relations.quote: “Shall I send a message to Vela?” he repeated blandly. “I’m sure you wish to see her and Khaede.”

relations.relation: 母子（幻象中的未来孩子）
relations.quote: I saw a child who looks like you but has my eyes. I want to meet that child one day.

relations.relation: 交战双方，正式和约尚未签订
relations.quote: given that no formal peace treaty has been signed as of yet

numbers.quote: All seven moons hung in a sky studded with thousands of constellations

numbers.context: 昏迷后两天里时醒时睡
numbers.quote: She drifted in and out of consciousness over the next two days

numbers.context: 南岸之战后第八天清晨
numbers.quote: Eight days after the battle of the southern shore, the morning sun pierced through Talasyn’s lids
The peace negotiations between the Night Empire and the Sardovian Allfold will be held here in six days.

numbers.context: 她在宫廷待了一年，学会听弦外之音
numbers.quote: Over the past year at court, she’d had to learn how to listen carefully to what was unspoken, and now there was a flicker of anxiety curling in her stomach.
